summary.text: Manny Guzman is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 127 who has served since December 1, 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Listed on Ballotpedia as Manuel Guzman, he works as a political consultant.

paragraphs.text: Manny Guzman graduated from Reading High School in 2006 and holds a bachelor's degree from Kutztown University of Pennsylvania.
His career experience includes working as a political consultant.
From 2013 to 2017 he served on the Reading School District Board of Directors as an at-large member.
Guzman assumed office on December 1, 2020, succeeding Thomas Caltagirone.

For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments as Appropriations (where he was subcommittee chair on Economic Impact and Infrastructure), Gaming Oversight, Liquor Control (as secretary), and Professional Licensure.
